name: zclass_world_write_settings_section
description: zClass_World::WriteSettingsSection serializes WorldSettings records for world nodes in bucket 13.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this callback; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4517a0 validates iterating bucket 13 through g_zClass_TypeList_HeadSlotPtrs, filling a 0x24-byte WorldSettings record through the pending fog getters, the duplicated GetPendingFogDensity call, passing the world node/name as the section token, and stopping when WriteSectionBlob returns 0.
The native smoke verifies writing a WorldSettings/arena ZBD record, payload size, record path, and serialized fog state, color, range, altitude, and density values.
